newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar lower, Aug/Oct spread widens.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar lower, Aug/Oct spread widens.

text.p: LIFFE sugar was mostly easier in afternoon trade on Tuesday, with a squeeze on August/October further widening the spread, traders said.
August expires on Wednesday. "There's still some untenderable sugar around," one trader said.
London was not fully responding to New York's fall, he said. "New York's getting some fund liquidation, but the whites aren't really following it down," he said.
By 1513 GMT, active October was 90 cents lower at $316.00 a tonne, while August was unchanged at $326.70.
Volume on October was 967 lots, with 532 lots done on August and a total so far of 2,211 lots.
